question.text: What will be the highest intraday value of the VVIX for the two-week period through November 27, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the maximum intraday value of the VVIX recorded from the market open on November 16, 2026 through November 27, 2026 (inclusive), according to the CBOE VVIX [Index Dashboard](https://www.cboe.com/us/indices/dashboard/VVIX)
question.fine_print: If the resolution source delays or ceases its reporting of these data, Metaculus might use alternative credible sources to resolve this question.

research:
I'm writing up what I found. The key fact: the VVIX jumped from about 90 to about 132 on Nov 5, 2026, during a sharp selloff, a week and a half before the window opens.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-05: Fetched pages from the Cboe VVIX Dashboard and from CNBC contained no numbers, so I could not read a live value from the official source. [Cboe](https://www.cboe.com/us/indices/dashboard/VVIX) [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/quotes/.VVIX)
- 2026-11-04: A search summary of the Cboe/CNBC pages gave a VVIX close of 90.41, a change of -16.99 (which fits the 107.40 close on Nov 3), and a 52-week range of 81.51 to 140.99. I did not see these pages directly. [Cboe](https://www.cboe.com/us/indices/dashboard/vvix/)
- 2026-11-05: Yahoo ^VVIX history: open 92.20, high **132.11**, low 92.20, close **130.64**. Yahoo showed an error banner on the page, so these figures need checking. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EVVIX/history/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing is settled yet. The window starts at the open on 2026-11-16 and has about 9 trading sessions:
  - Nov 16-20 and Nov 23-25
  - Nov 26 (Thanksgiving) should be closed and Nov 27 a half day. That is the normal US calendar; I did not confirm it for 2026.
- 2026-11-05: The VVIX closed around 130.6, which is in the top bucket (≥120). How fast it falls back over the next 7 trading days is the main question.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-05:
  - Big selloff. The Dow fell about 3.4% (roughly 1,800 points), the S&P 500 about 4.3% and the Nasdaq about 5.5%, putting the Nasdaq in correction territory. Chip stocks (SOX index) fell more than 10%.
  - The VIX closed at 26.55 (+60%) after an intraday high of about 27.45 to 28.09 (sources differ). Yahoo called it the biggest one-day VIX jump in over two years.
  - Causes cited: an unwind of the crowded AI trade, fear that the new Democratic Congress will slow AI data-center buildouts, the biggest retail selling day since March 2020 (Vanda Research), and oil rising on uncertainty over a US-Iran deal. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-thursday-november-5-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-oil-rises-chip-stocks-141439950.html) [Reuters/Investing](https://investing.com/news/stock-market-news/wall-street-fear-gauge-jumps-most-since-liberation-day-as-ai-trade-stumbles-5005364)
- 2026-11-04: Stocks rallied after Democrats swept Congress. The Dow rose about 3%, oil fell about 7-8%, and the VIX dropped about 20% to 16.61. [Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/26/11/62886507/trump-celebrates-stock-rally-fueled-by-his-own-partys-midterm-defeat) [JournalArta](https://journalarta.com/en/2026/11/05/wall-street-close-dow-surges-3-03-as-brent-falls-8-22-and-vix-drops/)
- 2026-11-02: CNBC said the VIX's reaction to the worst stock week since June had been "muted" (closing at 19.4 on Oct 30), pointing to managers cutting exposure rather than buying hedges. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/wall-streets-fear-index-is-doing-something-strange-heres-what-it-means-for-stocks.html)

## 4. Base rates (Yahoo daily data) [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EVVIX/history/)
- Aug 5 to Oct 13, 2026: a calm stretch.
  - Daily highs were mostly 85-97, with only one above 100 (103.24 on Sep 10).
  - Two-week maximums were roughly 90-103.
- Oct 14 to Nov 5, 2026: a stressed stretch with repeated spikes:
  - 121.17 on Oct 16 and 118.17 on Oct 23
  - 124.06 on Oct 30 and 111.85 on Nov 2
  - 132.11 on Nov 5
- Two-week maximums since mid-October have all been 110 or higher.
- Lows in between fell back to the high 80s or 90s within days, for example 88.38 on Nov 4 after a 111 high on Nov 3. Day-to-day swings of 10-40 points have been common recently.
- Long-run context from the search summary (not verified): the 2006-2026 average is about 94 and the range is 36-208. [Cboe](https://www.cboe.com/us/indices/dashboard/vvix/)
- Commentary claims (not verified with data):
  - VIX tends to fall after elections, and one trader cited a November average of about -4%. [IBTimes](https://www.ibtimes.com/wall-street-getting-nervous-about-whats-next-investors-hedge-against-negative-risk-trinity-3807361)
  - J.P. Morgan said volatility often peaks before the vote. [Webull](https://www.webull.com/news/15656884897776640)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the VVIX. None of the pre-collected markets match this question.
- The closest is Kalshi's Fear & Greed Index for Nov 6: Extreme Fear 0.48, Fear 0.47. That suggests stress is expected to carry into the next day.
- I found no expert VVIX forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before or during the window
- 2026-11-06: October jobs report (named as the next major data point). [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-thursday-november-5-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-oil-rises-chip-stocks-141439950.html)
- 2026-11-17, after the close: Nvidia's fiscal Q3 2027 earnings, with the call at 5pm ET. CME says Nvidia confirmed the date on Oct 28; some calendars still list Nov 18. Given the AI-led selloff, this is likely the biggest catalyst inside the window. [CME](https://www.cmelitegroup.com/knowledge-hub/nvidia-earnings-date-fiscal-q3-2027-report-time-guidance-and-expected-move/?nocache=1)
- 2026-11-18: November VIX futures and options expiry. [Macroption](https://www.macroption.com/vix-expiration-calendar/)
- Around 2026-11-20: monthly equity options expiration (standard third Friday, not verified).
- Thanksgiving week (Nov 26 closed, Nov 27 half day) usually has thin trading.
- Other risks: US-Iran and oil headlines, and AI regulation talk after the midterms. The next FOMC meeting is probably in December, after the window; I did not confirm the date.

## 1. Resolution source
- The Cboe VVIX dashboard named in the criteria ([cboe.com](https://www.cboe.com/us/indices/dashboard/VVIX)) showed no numbers when fetched; the page apparently loads its data separately.
- 2026-11-05: Cboe's delayed-quote feed for the same index shows VVIX at 131.19 (open 92.20, high 132.11, low 92.20, previous close 90.41). Last trade was 15:48 ET. [Cboe delayed quote JSON](https://cdn-api.cboe.com/api/global/delayed_quotes/quotes/_VVIX.json)

## 2. Current status

## 4. Base rates (VVIX closes, Cboe CSV)
- Range since 2006 is about 36 to 208, average about 94. [Cboe](https://www.cboe.com/us/indices/dashboard/vvix/)
- 2026 peaks:
  - March (Middle East war stress): closes from 110 to 140, with a high of 140.44 on 03-06.
  - January: 117.05. February: 117.07.
  - April to mid-October: mostly 83-100, with spikes to 108.16 (06-10), 109.47 (07-29) and 102.66 (09-10).
- Since mid-October the level has been higher:
  - 10-16: 109.91; 10-22: 107.94; 10-23: 109.70; 10-30: 106.43; 11-02: 110.47; 11-03: 107.40; 11-04: 90.41.
  - 11-05: about 131 intraday.
- Highest close in recent two-week windows:
  - Quiet stretches (Aug to mid-Oct 2026): about 87-103.
  - Stressed stretches: about 110-140.
- Intraday highs usually run a few points to 10+ points above the close on spike days.
- Comparable period: Nov 18-22, 2024 closes ranged 93.8-102.2.
- The VVIX tends to fall back quickly after spikes. For example, it closed at 140 on 2026-03-06 and was back at 95-105 within about 5-6 weeks. In December 2024 it went from 136 to 91 in 3 sessions.
- This round of stress began only today, and the window opens 7 trading days from now.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** The window opens at the market open on Nov 16, 2026, 11 days from now. It runs through the half-day session on Nov 27, about 8.5 trading sessions. The outcome will be known on Nov 27, with resolution around Dec 1.

(b) **Status quo:** The VVIX closed around 130.6 on Nov 5 after an intraday high of 132.11, which is in the ≥120 bucket. If stress simply persisted, the window maximum would land at 120 or above. However, VVIX spikes usually fade within days. On Nov 4 it fell from 107 to the high 80s overnight, so the level now says little about the level 7 trading days ahead.

(c) **Base rates:**
- In the calm regime (Aug to mid-Oct 2026), two-week maximums ran about 90-103. That mostly falls in the 90-100 bucket, sometimes 100-110.
- In the stressed regime since mid-October, every two-week maximum was 110 or higher (121, 124, 132).
- The long-run VVIX average is about 94. A two-week maximum below 90 is uncommon even in calm periods, because intraday highs sit several points above closes.
- Past shocks give some guide to what happens 1.5 to 3.5 weeks after a spike:
  - After the Aug 2024 spike, late-month maximums were roughly 100-110.
